# Feature status

<!-- Generated by scripts/check-feature-status.mjs from frontend/lib/capabilities.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Run `node scripts/check-feature-status.mjs --write` after changing capabilities.
CI fails if a `mock` capability is advertised as Available.

| Feature | Capability key | Mode | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Agent chat | `chat` | `api` | Available |
| Tasks | `tasks` | `api` | Available |
| Activity and audit | `activity` | `api` | Available |
| Telegram channel | `telegram` | `api` | Available |
| Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive) | `google` | `api` | Available |
| Memory | `memory` | `api` | Available |
| Automations and scheduler | `automations` | `api` | Available |

`api` means the UI is backed by the live backend. `mock` means simulated data and
must not be presented as a working feature.
